title: Santa Cruz Charters
blurb: Guests fish for salmon, halibut, lingcod, white seabass, albacore tuna, and pacific snapper in Monterey Bay aboard a 32x12 foot, 630 horsepower sport fishing sedan. The boat accommodates up to six people and offers on the water picnics, marine and wildlife eco-tours, team building, and private parties. The charter is family friendly and teaches guests how to catch fish.
